name: directives/apply-sibling-pair
description: `@apply` for sibling-pair plugins (`space-x-*`, `divide-x-*`). These resolve with a non-default selector_suffix (` > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden])`); upstream emits them as sibling rules even in the variant-free case so the suffix can land. Variant-bearing `@apply hover:space-x-4` then nests `:hover` BEFORE the suffix.
